<thought>The spectrum shows a strong M+1 peak (~16% of base) consistent with many carbons (C13 isotopic contribution) and a prominent M+2 peak (~33% of base) matching the characteristic chlorine isotopic pattern (35Cl/37Cl ≈ 3:1). No other element shows its distinctive isotopic signature. Therefore, carbon and chlorine can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Cl']</final_answer>
